scope: Receipt-based methods provenance. No command was rerun; no FASTQ or abundance file was rehashed in this step.

read_preprocessing.layout: paired-end; raw validation shows 150 nt min=max for both mates in every library
read_preprocessing.fastp_command_contract: -i/-I paired inputs; -o/-O paired outputs; --thread 2; --compression 2; --detect_adapter_for_pe; --trim_poly_g --poly_g_min_len 10; Q15; unqualified-percent limit40; N limit5; length-required50; dup_calc_accuracy1; --dont_overwrite

quantification.library_type: unstranded (validated pilot; no strand flag in actual commands)

primary.reference: Picea_v1.0b N-free exact CDS sequence-equivalence units

allN.reference: all exact units including original-N models; annotation/reference sensitivity

competition.reference: primary host targets plus Phialocephala scopiformis CDS proxy; host-attribution sensitivity only
competition.proxy_identity_and_limit: Exact P. sphaeroides reference was unavailable in frozen reference evidence; P. scopiformis is a near-species proxy. Shared-31mer diagnostics identify attribution risk but do not prove contamination/origin.

statistical_models.units: CDS sequence-equivalence units, not verified one-gene-per-row entities
statistical_models.primary_import: tximport kallisto, countsFromAbundance=no, then DESeqDataSetFromTximport so tximport average effective-length information contributes normalization factors
statistical_models.primary_fit: DESeq2 1.46.0; betaPrior=FALSE; fitType=parametric; parallel=FALSE; minReplicatesForReplace=Inf; eligible when estimated fragments >=10 in at least 3 samples
statistical_models.edgeR_sensitivity: tximport countsFromAbundance=lengthScaledTPM; edgeR 4.4.0 TMM (calcNormFactors), robust=TRUE dispersion and QL fit; no separate length offset; same design/fixed eligible universe
statistical_models.families: interaction BH over eligible units; all four simple effects jointly BH over 4*m. The five contrast vectors are stored in each route analysis_metadata.json.
statistical_models.implementation_note: dropInfReps=TRUE was the isolated import-only repair to avoid an unavailable HDF5 inference-replicate dependency; it preserves abundance.h5 and does not change counts/abundance/length used by the model.

caveats: competition is an attribution sensitivity with P. scopiformis proxy, not a P. sphaeroides quantification or independent validation.
All sensitivity routes/methods reuse the same 12 libraries.
Receipt consistency supports reproducibility of the implemented workflow; it does not itself establish biological interpretation or final publication readiness.
